This indicates a potential cascade where Kutzneride 9 influences ERK activity, which in turn modulates the ATPase activity. The second pathway connects Kutzneride 9 to Phenylalanine-4-hydroxylase, which is targeted by D-Glutamic Acid, which also targets the ATPase subunits. This suggests that Kutzneride 9 may influence metabolic pathways that ultimately affect ATPase function. Both pathways provide evidence of a potential mechanism by which Kutzneride 9 could interact with the ATPase subunits, though the exact nature of the interaction remains unclear. The scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct involvement of Kutzneride 9 in the regulation of the ATPase subunits.
